description: This file is an HTML webpage that serves as a frontend interface for a database viewer application. It includes layout, styles, and client-side JavaScript for fetching database information, tables, and data, and for rendering the user interface interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the interface.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a specific table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data as an HTML table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
